_comment: Layout values chosen by sweeping margin, size and leading against the real content and keeping what fits one page with every rule satisfied. An earlier guess of 10.4pt over 7.30in came from prose typography and put the document on two pages: this content volume is fixed and generous, which is exactly why the original used 0.40in margins. See tests/test_resume_layout.py.
_fit_comment: Applied in order, re-measuring after each. Font size is never touched: shrinking type to fit is the failure this project exists to undo. Honors come off before SBSF because honors are decoration that costs the same two lines as a real employment entry, and the user's own base resume omits them.

fit_steps.label: inline education honors onto the degree line
